title: Store-Bought vs Local Vegan Mac 'N' Cheese: Three-Way Tasting and a Homemade Sauce
summary: This Goodful video presents a friendly comparison of three vegan mac and cheese options: two store-bought boxed products and a homemade version made with mostly locally sourced ingredients. Host Merle announces a store-bought versus locally sourced vegan mac and cheese challenge, then demonstrates how to prepare a homemade sauce by boiling carrot, potato, and onion, saving some cooking water, and blending the vegetables into a creamy sauce. Throughout the tasting, the host shares personality-driven commentary and environmental rationale for choosing plant-based meals, noting that vegan choices can reduce greenhouse gas emissions and food waste. The segment culminates in a taste test where the local-market mac is highlighted for its ingredients and flavor, while remarks acknowledge that plant-based does not always equal traditional cheese in texture. The video blends practical cooking steps with environmental messaging and light humor to encourage viewers to incorporate vegan meals into their routines.

The segment closes with reflections on veganism as an environmental choice and a reminder that even partial dietary shifts can have environmental benefits.
